decisions.decision: Store each fund's named custodian, prime broker, transfer agent and authorized participant roles with effective dates. Never allocate fund holdings to a custodian unless the filing discloses an amount.
decisions.reason: Grayscale and 21Shares have multiple custodians; the actual balance split is unknown.

decisions.decision: Track cash and in-kind creation/redemption as separate flows. Record AP, asset delivered, creation/redemption date and actual onchain transfer only when disclosed or verified.
decisions.reason: Grayscale enabled in-kind XRP exchange on September 29, but actual volume and AP sourcing venue are unknown.

decisions.decision: Do not equate ETF AUM or custody assets with new spot purchases. Require net share creation, XRP units created/redeemed and AP sourcing/transfer evidence.
decisions.reason: ETF holdings are a stock; AUM also changes with price, and in-kind flows may not produce a contemporaneous cash-market buy.

decisions.decision: Represent Coinbase as a multi-role institutional node (exchange, prime broker, custodian, principal-market reference, x402 protocol originator) while preserving multi-custodian and competing-venue objections.
decisions.reason: SEC filings show broad institutional service relationships but also custody diversification.
